text_block_list.text:
One day off, when I went out into town,
I saw Gold City lingering
in front of a shoe store.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Right now...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe those earlier pumps made my feet
look more delicate and cute?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
M-Makes you look dainty...!
I see, that's another way to look at it~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...As you can see, I'm supervising their shopping.
Kind of like their chaperone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Both Yukino-chan and Curren
have things we want~, so we thought
we'd ask City-san for advice♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, City-san...!
Between pumps and loafers,
which do you think is better...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... For Yukino's wardrobe,
loafers might be more versatile.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you're trying something new, footwear is an easy place to start.
If you're looking for a fresh mood with new shoes, I'd probably recommend pumps.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...! I-I'll go buy
some pumps!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Do your best.
...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan, I'm glad you found something nice♪
Well then, it's Curren's turn next.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't you join in too, Trainer-san?
Curren wants to hear all kinds of opinions~☆
Please~♪

And so, swept along by Curren Chan's
request, I ended up watching over
the three of them as they shopped—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...So yeah~ Curren's pretty curious about this kind of lotion,
but what's its reputation like in the industry?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hawawa, I have no idea what Curren-san is talkin' about, nope...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
As expected, you're quick to get info.
It really is starting to trend, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
From what the makeup artist said, it seems best to hold off
a bit longer. If the effects are similar,
the other natural-style one is more cost-effective anyway.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see~. Then I'll do just that.
I'm so glad I asked a true pro~♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah.
...I mean, now that Curren's decided, are we dismissed for today?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! Curren wants to see City-san shopping too, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I-I want to see too! City-san is always
giving me advice and stuff, so..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Please let me learn from your style
as a bona fide "City Girl" out shopping!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Even if you say that, it's just normal to me.
Nothing I feel like I absolutely *must* have, either...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Just "kind of interested"
would be more than enough...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, don't you have any idea
what City-san might want?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Why are you asking this guy?

Watching Gold City's behavior,
I had a good idea of what was on her mind.
And that was...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? How do you... know that?
choice_data_list: Because you've been worried about your shoes the whole time.

text_block_list.text:
During yesterday's training, she kept looking at her feet, too.
And earlier at the shoe store, while Yukino Bijin was shopping,
I feel like she was sneaking glances at the running shoes as well.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~, you're so observant.
I didn't notice at aaaall!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's one way to put it~...
Anyway, how about we go look
at some training shoes for now?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Just wondering~... You wouldn't happen to know
which shoes would be best too, would you~?
I wasn't entirely confident, but I managed to find something that seemed close to her taste.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Eh.
No way... am I actually right!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, as expected! You're really observant~☆
...Wait, is that really all this is~?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...! Don't hit me with that...
For some reason, she glared at me...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Why?
choice_data_list: Because it's usually snack time right now.

text_block_list.text:
To avoid going for long stretches on an empty stomach,
she always spaced out her meals and had little snacks throughout the day.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hae~... She looks super model-like...!
Ah, well, she IS a model, though!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right? So thorough♪
Curren's in the mood for something sweet, too. How about some crepes?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? City-san,
are you just having a drink?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's for calorie control.
...Even though the crepes look so good.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hae~...! A real model...!

...Gold City looks kind of down.
Maybe she actually wanted to eat a crepe...
Thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...That's what you ordered.
You haven't even taken a single bite.
choice_data_list: I'm not as hungry as I thought... Please take this!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Dummy.
You're way too soft."
Despite saying so, Gold City looked rather happy as she took the crepe.
